direction: The raising. Ropes thrown over a timber sheerleg, the carter and two lay brothers haul, and the oxen take the strain while the cross rises upright and drops into its socket beside the church door. Packing stones are rammed in. Slow tilt up the shaft as it settles.

captions.text: The Irbic cross was carved and set up at Llandough in the 10th–11th century. The day of its raising is a recreation.
